title: Spares and warehouse in the core
goal: The core keeps spare counts per component model, new and used, as NERV does
acceptance: The spares data and its operations (upsert, adjust, set counts, get, find by text and category, list by category, replace a part using a new or used spare) move into src/fpv-core, behaviour unchanged, counts never below zero
Tests carried over or rewritten with invented component models, including the replace-part transaction
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A behaviour difference from NERV's FPV pack is recorded and goes to the owner before it lands

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: about 150 lines of store code plus their cases. Not a measurement.
